name: Parametry UG
description: The project aims for a decentralized autonomous organization for Earth orbitoperations named "Space DAO" based on blockchain consensus mechanisms. Earth’s Orbit is populated by satellites and other assets from all governments. Currently, decisions regarding satellites and spacecraft operations are made by a very limited number of entities. The rigid governance of the centralized information in space is leading to delays, errors, and potential safety hazards. The main Idea is to implement a decentralised market place where CDM (Conjunction Data Message, similar to collision predictions) providers and data processing contributors can interact seamlessly without need for a trusted central authority to validate conjunction alerts and reach consensus on collisions probabilities and orbit maneuvers. Core of the project is to initiate Space DAO, a decentralized autonomous organization that democratizes access to space by leveraging blockchain technology. It is planed to be an open-source platform that connects satellite operators, ground station owners, and data buyers in a peer-to-peer network, allowing them to transact directly with each other without the need for intermediaries.

ZONUINBIO is crucial for both, precision medicine on Earth and health in space for detection. Its relevance is spanning from prevention of acute reactions, but also diseases associated with gut inflammation, including inflammatory bowel disease, such as Crohn’s disease. Under space conditions (e.g. micro-gravity, radiation, stress), astronauts suffer from gut barrier disorders that trigger inflammation and immunodeficiency. ZONUINBIO offers a much-needed precise diagnostic option in Orbit, but also pre and post missions. Space medicine serves also as a catalyst for innovations in terrestrial diagnostics.

We offer our customers in agricultural vegetable growing, farm shops, company canteens and educational institutions complete systems with which they can grow their own vegetables locally, in a water-saving, fertiliser-efficient and climate-friendly way. For this purpose, we provide the appropriate vertical racks, our own fertiliser and automatic measurement and control technology (MCT). This measurement and control technology measures the current nutrient content and the pH value and corrects these two parameters independently. In addition, environmental parameters are recorded and stored by the fertiliser computer. The aim of this application (Space Connection) is to further develop the MCT. description: Claudia Rougoor, a civil engineer, founded PreserviTec GmbH in 2025. PreserviTec's core business idea is to provide a state-of-the-art software prototype for building inspections. This integrated solution is designed to transform the way inspections are conducted, both in the construction sector, particularly for federal road bridges, and in the cultural heritage sectors. Using (autonomous) drone systems, AI-based image analysis including material recognition are the cornerstones of PreserviTec's approach, enabling faster, more accurate, cost-effective, and sustainable inspection services to meet the evolving needs of these markets. PreserviTec demonstrates how space technology and earth-based applications are interconnected by harnessing the space sector's advances in (autonomous) drones, advanced imaging, and data analytics. This strategic use of space-connected technologies not only gives PreserviTec a competitive edge but also brings significant benefits, including improved safety, streamlined inspection processes, and a tangible reduction in environmental impact. This integration highlights the potential for innovation and collaboration between space technology and building inspection.

name: PRIOjet GmbH
description: PRIOjet Logistics, an innovative start-up co-founded by Christian Wolff and Rico Förster, is transforming emergency logistics with its specialized SaaS platform. The platform enables companies, logistics agencies and on-board couriers worldwide to handle their urgent logistics orders faster, safer, CO2 neutral and more cost-effectivley. Emergency logistics involves the rapid international transportation of critical items such as spare parts for an aircraft or machine, production equipment, documents, medical material, and more. Traditionally, these very important transports have been organized inefficiently, using a hodgepodge of communication tools. PRIOjet Logistics addresses this issue by providing a streamlined digital platform that guarantees neutrality and data protection, per German standards. The platform allows logistics agencies to directly contact and assign the best on-board courier for their customer's emergency logistics order, calculate and organize the order, integrate additional service providers, and execute the order with intelligent IT support. An outstanding feature of PRIOjet is its upcoming use of a combination of data sources for localization data to optimize the global track & trace system. This system uses data from courier, the shipment and aircraft movements, weather events, and historical mission data to enable dynamic courier deployment. An integral part of this system is the use of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) data for real-time courier location and comprehensive shipment tracking. These innovative features make PRIOjet a unique solution in the emergency logistics market, filling a significant gap for a standardized, efficient system to manage highly urgent transportation orders.

name: Productionary
description: PRODUCTIONARY offers a cutting-edge, AI-powered 3D shop floor visualization software, paired with an intuitive mobile app and live database. This deep-tech solution provides space manufacturers with complete workflow transparency in production, a single source of truth, and a cost-effective way to capture critical shop floor data in real time. Designed for agility and ease of use, PRODUCTIONARY empowers European space manufacturer to maximize the efficiency of their high-end resources and manufacturing equipment on the shop floor. In the space industry, where traceability is fundamental, PRODUCTIONARY enhances this capability by tracking detailed data on every component’s journey throughout the entire production process. By intelligently orchestrating all the key resources across the complex, labour-intensive manufacturing steps in space production, PRODUCTIONARY makes existing shop floor workflows more efficient. On top of that, the insights gained from real-time data collection help accelerate innovation and streamline manufacturing cycles, driving faster progress in the European space industry.
